noise_model.invalid_inputs: nonfinite or negative input => NaN => candidate contributes sigma2=0 and increments conf_degraded; never throws
noise_model.registration_sigma_contract: provider-delivered isotropic 1-sigma position uncertainty in source px; registration_residual_factor/model_prediction_factor are quality factors and are NOT consumed as variances; upstream folds prediction into the delivered sigma
noise_model.plan_schema: FrameSamplingTransform persists registration_residual_factor/residual_applicable/model_prediction_factor only; the sigma provider fields and plan schema extension are delegated to gate 7 (artifact/resume gate)

sufficient_statistics.storage: 3 extra doubles per pixel/channel + degraded counter; O(1) state, feeds gate-5 buffer sizing

effective_set_contract.reservoir_sigma_clip: clip-accepted reservoir members (inside the clip call, no post pass); B/B2/n_eff still cover the full stream per gate-3
effective_set_contract.mom_winsorized_groups / mom_trimmed_grou: surviving groups' frames; winsorized keeps all groups, trimmed drops clipped groups

confidence.formula: confidence = S_c^2/(S_c^2 + C_c) in (0,1]; identical to n_eff/(n_eff+1) when all sigma equal
confidence.fallback: C_c == 0 with B_c > 0 => confidence = n_eff/(n_eff+1), state fallback_n_eff
confidence.support_invariant: verified: sigma inputs change no b/value/n_eff/support fields

numerics_decision.compensated_fp32_neumaier: REJECTED vs 1e-12: 1.78e-10 on long_stream_1e5; meets on the other four
numerics_decision.fp64: SELECTED for all per-pixel accumulators (A/B/B2 and B_c/S_c/C_c); rel err 0 vs oracle, matches existing fold and robust code
numerics_decision.affine_geometry: fp64 (matches gate-0 oracle and gate-1 scatter kernel inputs)

cpu_gpu_tolerances.confidence_cpu_gpu: 1e-12 reserved; GPU confidence accumulation is a gate-6 batch-fold concern - no GPU confidence kernel exists yet
cpu_gpu_tolerances.sigma2_model: fp64 host-side per candidate; provider may deliver fp32 inputs widened to fp64

adversarial_verification.gate3_matrix_with_sigma: 21 cases: all modeled confidences finite in (0,1]; degraded path verified separately
adversarial_verification.missing_sigma: state fallback_n_eff, confidence = n_eff/(n_eff+1), support untouched
adversarial_verification.nonfinite_negative_sigma: counted in conf_degraded, contributes sigma2=0, not fatal
adversarial_verification.wrong_span_size: invalid_argument on both robust entry points
adversarial_verification.determinism: reservoir hash and confidence accumulation are pure functions of the input spans

deferred: gate 7: FrameSamplingTransform schema extension for sigma_noise_f / sigma_reg_f providers + resume contract
gate 5: buffer sizing must add 3 doubles + counter per pixel/channel for confidence
gate 6: device-resident confidence accumulation + CPU/GPU 1e-12 parity measurement

tests.gate4_hidden_matrix: 5 numerics sequences + 21 adversarial confidence cases, results JSONL
